segments.title: Guided tour of the site
segments.text: [[lab:top]] Welcome to the labs! Here, we don’t look at machines from far away: we take them apart. [[lab:step:1]] This is a wheel, seen at an angle. In a lab, you can walk around it, isolate a part, cut it open. [[lab:step:2]] Then everything comes undone, and every part has its own sheet: an overview, its specifications, how to look after it. [[lab:step:3]] And once it is all back together, the machine runs again: a live simulation, where you change the settings and read what comes out. [[lab:section:labs]] Here are the labs. Each one is a site of its own, with its machine and its question. The filters sort them by field, and each card gives the level and the time. Open one, play, and come back here to pick the next. [[lab:section:inside]] Inside every lab, you find the same bearings: views in three dimensions, a sheet for every part, an assembly guide, a simulation, drawings, short lessons. And a voice like this one. [[lab:section:about]] A word of honesty, said just once. These labs are independent educational reconstructions: neither official drawings nor makers’ products. The sources are credited here, and inside every lab. This voice is a synthetic voice. And these labs are for understanding, not for building without care: electricity, water, fire and gas have their rules. [[lab:section:labs]] Over to you!
